plan.question: Can the planning interface produce consistent quantities and a capacity/time feasible route, and actually respond to joint risk?

data.observed_truth: engineering acceptance of planning contracts; not a field-effect or prediction superiority test

evaluation.success_rule: all acceptance assertions pass, zero constraint violations; positive virtual routing example; no real dispatch
evaluation.failure_rule: any unsafe result or failed acceptance assertion meansnot_supported; preservelogs
evaluation.exclusion_rule: No field data; execute all preregistered fixtures and edge cases, no failure exclusion.
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: Deterministic engineering acceptance, exact small-case routing; no population confidence interval, no field effectiveness inference.
evaluation.seed_plan: No stochastic training; supplied finite4member scenarios and deterministic ordered solver/route selection.
